summary.text: Jesse Topper is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 78, which he has represented since a February 2014 special election, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
On November 12, 2024, Topper was elected minority leader of the House, succeeding Bryan Cutler.

paragraphs.text: Topper earned a B.A. in music performance from Frostburg State University, and Ballotpedia lists his professional experience as including work as a minister.
Topper took office on February 10, 2014, after winning a special election, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House Education Committee and served on the Rules Committee.
